meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装好后,当你规划 Azure 部署或选择区域时,Claude 会查看订阅配额,返回各类资源的限制、已用量和剩余容量,并能在配额不足时帮你提交调高请求。它优先使用 Azure CLI 命令,而非门户或 REST API。
howto.when: 当你说到‘检查配额’、‘配额超限’、‘请求增加配额’等关键词,或要求验证容量、查看 vCPU 可用量、选择区域时触发。

say.text: 我的 vCPU 配额不够,帮我申请把 eastus 的配额提高到 500。
say.note: 提交配额调高请求并查询状态。

howto.what_en: After setup, when planning an Azure deployment or choosing a region, Claude checks your subscription quotas, reports limits, usage and available capacity, submits increase requests when needed, and can compare regional availability. It uses Azure CLI first, not Portal or REST API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'check quotas', 'quota exceeded', 'request quota increase', or ask to validate capacity or compare regions.

say_en.text: Check my Microsoft.Compute quota and usage in eastus.
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare available quota for standardDSv3Family in eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Lists quota data for both regions.

say_en.text: My vCPU quota is low; request an increase to 500 in eastus.
say_en.note: Submits the increase request and checks status.
